steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with two bids without creating or searching for another event.
Continue in Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared RFQ's pricing round on the vendor portal.
Verify the pricing screen identifies Vendor A as the current vendor.
Verify the vendor-side pricing screen shows Vendor A's own bid figure.
Assert that the pricing view does not expose the other bidder's identity or related bid information.
Check that the vendor pricing screen renders without data-leak indicators such as raw or malformed competitor data.
Inspect the vendor-facing event overview for competitor information.
Assert that the overview also does not expose Vendor B.
Check that the vendor overview renders cleanly.
